plugin.name: ob-decor
plugin._long: Server-side window decorations themed by openbox themerc (via libobtheme), plus an outer ring border.

option.name: theme
option._long: Openbox theme name (searched in ~/.themes etc., openbox-3/themerc). Empty = labwc built-in defaults.

option.name: font
option._long: Pango font description for the titlebar text (themerc carries no window fonts, same as labwc).

option.name: titlebar_layout
option._long: labwc syntax: optional "left:right" split on a single colon, buttons comma-separated (icon|menu|iconify|max|close|shade|desk).

option.name: ring_width
option._long: Width of the extra decorative ring drawn outside the theme border.

option.name: ignore_views
option._long: Views matching this criteria will not be decorated.

option.name: forced_views
option._long: Force decorations on the views matching this criteria.
